mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM text_lookup WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND service = #{service} AND tried_at >= #{since})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO text_lookup (work_id, service, tried_at, found) VALUES (#{workId}, #{service}, now(), #{found}) ON CONFLICT (work_id, service) DO UPDATE SET tried_at = now(), found = EXCLUDED.found
